description: Editorial taxonomy for News Dispatch. Streams answer what domain a dispatch belongs to; rubrics answer what analytical lens is used; issue_types answer what product format is being published; reader_sections preserve the recurring reader-facing blocks inside an issue.

rubrics.title: Reg Watch
rubrics.description: Regulation, laws, courts, licensing, supervision, sanctions, AML/KYC/KYT and other formal rule-making or enforcement signals.
rubrics.source_requirement: Primary regulator, court, official document or legal text is preferred. Without primary source, publish only as limited note or draft.

rubrics.title: Market Structure
rubrics.description: Market participants, exchanges, liquidity, custody, settlement, payment rails, pricing, intermediaries and business-model shifts.
rubrics.source_requirement: Use at least one primary or high-reliability source for high-impact market claims; media-only signals must be labelled.

rubrics.title: Infrastructure
rubrics.description: Hardware, data centers, APIs, networks, chips, supply chain, payment rails, production constraints and platform dependencies.
rubrics.source_requirement: Separate research, vendor claims, media reports and production readiness. Do not treat lab signals as commercial availability.

rubrics.title: Product / Platform
rubrics.description: Product releases, platform changes, UX, developer tools, ecosystem lock-in, distribution and workflow changes.
rubrics.source_requirement: Prefer primary product release, changelog, developer documentation or official blog; separate release fact from adoption hypothesis.

rubrics.title: Security / Abuse
rubrics.description: Vulnerabilities, fraud, abuse patterns, model misuse, distillation, leaks, operational risk and trust failures.
rubrics.source_requirement: Use primary disclosure, vendor statement, CVE/advisory, court/regulator document or multiple independent reports. Accusations remain claims unless independently verified.

rubrics.title: Research / Evidence
rubrics.description: Papers, preprints, peer review, benchmarks, lab reports, replication status and research-to-product translation.
rubrics.source_requirement: Mark whether the work is peer-reviewed, preprint, corporate lab report, benchmark or unknown. Avoid overstating external validity.

rubrics.title: Consumer / Use
rubrics.description: User scenarios, ownership signals, usability, durability, local availability, practical value and material-culture use cases.
rubrics.source_requirement: Community evidence must be classified by pattern type. Isolated complaints are not proof of a general defect.

rubrics.title: City / Culture
rubrics.description: Moscow, venues, events, public spaces, transport, cultural infrastructure, food/bar scenes and local service changes.
rubrics.source_requirement: Prefer official city source, venue page, organizer source or reliable city media; separate listing fact from recommendation.

rubrics.title: Weak Signals
rubrics.description: Telegram, X, Reddit, forums, comments, hiring, patents, GitHub activity, on-chain anomalies and indirect early indicators.
rubrics.source_requirement: Weak signals are never facts. Use only with explicit labelling, confidence level and what would confirm or falsify the signal.

issue_types.title: Daily Radar Review
issue_types.description: Short editorial review of retained public signals. It may group and classify signals but should not overstate conclusions.

issue_types.title: Weekly Digest
issue_types.description: Synthesis of the most consequential developments over a week by stream and rubric. Not a raw RSS recap.

issue_types.title: Reg Brief
issue_types.description: Focused regulatory note around one document, proceeding, enforcement signal or rule-making process.

issue_types.title: Claim Check
issue_types.description: Verification-focused issue around one disputed or high-impact claim.

issue_types.title: Market Structure Note
issue_types.description: Analysis of changes in market participants, rails, intermediaries, custody, liquidity or settlement.

issue_types.title: Infrastructure Radar
issue_types.description: Signals around hardware, software, compute, networks, production constraints and platform dependencies.

issue_types.title: Source Dossier
issue_types.description: Source-first review of what is confirmed, what is media-reported and what remains unverified.

issue_types.title: Special Issue
issue_types.description: Cross-domain issue where the relationship between several streams is the main point.

reader_sections.title: Issue Panel
reader_sections.purpose: A compact metadata panel: stream, rubric, issue type, period, confidence and publication mode.

reader_sections.title: Executive Brief
reader_sections.purpose: A short decision-grade summary of the main signal, mechanism and uncertainty.

reader_sections.title: Main Editorial Essay
reader_sections.purpose: The central analytical narrative connecting facts, mechanism and second-order effects.

reader_sections.title: Key Signals
reader_sections.purpose: A structured list of important signals with source class and confidence.

reader_sections.title: Community Radar
reader_sections.purpose: User/community evidence classified as complaints, repeated patterns, regressions, bad batches or subjective preferences.

reader_sections.title: Buying and Material-Culture Radar
reader_sections.purpose: Product, gear, EDC and ownership-oriented evidence; never advertising or affiliate copy.

reader_sections.title: Finance and Consumer Environment
reader_sections.purpose: Impact on consumer finance, rates, payments, banks, ruble, cards and household financial context.

reader_sections.title: Horizon Notes
reader_sections.purpose: Longer-horizon technology, science, culture and infrastructure signals that are too early for firm conclusions.

reader_sections.title: Signal vs Noise
reader_sections.purpose: What should be treated as meaningful, what should be ignored, and what needs more evidence.

reader_sections.title: Risks and Limits
reader_sections.purpose: Known uncertainty, missing sources, contradictory evidence and possible analytical errors.

reader_sections.title: Decisions with Criteria
reader_sections.purpose: Non-directive criteria for monitoring, publication, source review or future editorial prioritization.

reader_sections.title: Change in Worldview
reader_sections.purpose: What the reader should understand differently after the issue, and what evidence would reverse it.
